# Sovereign Account
> A universal primitive for sovereign identity, authority, and execution.

## Domains
- [Account](./domain/account/index.md): Sovereign identity, authority derivation, and execution decision model.

## Reference
- [Glossary](./glossary.md): All concepts with stable identifiers.

## Domain: Account

### Ubiquitous Language
- [Index](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/index.md)
- [01 — Foundations](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/01-foundations.md): Purpose, external context, Subject, Identity, Account, sovereignty.
- [02 — Authority Model](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/02-authority-model.md): Authority, Capability, Credential, Credential Authority.
- [03 — Authorization](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/03-authorization.md): Proof, Verifier, Requested Authority, Authorization, Validation, Replay Protection.
- [04 — Derived Authority](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/04-derived-authority.md): Session, Delegation, Delegatee, Restriction, Effective Authority, Authority Abstraction.
- [05 — State and Policy](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/05-state-and-policy.md): Authorization State, Transitions, Policy, Policy Effect, Policy Consumption.
- [06 — Execution Model](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/06-execution-model.md): Domain Action, Execution Request, Target, Context, Constraints, Runtime, Engine, Adapter.
- [07 — Reference](./domain/account/ubiquitous-language/07-reference.md): Classification, Identifier semantics, Stress Test, Architectural principles, Consolidated model.
